listen_addr.description: IP address on which the proxy listens for incoming IMAP connections.

listen_port.description: Port on which the proxy listens for incoming IMAP connections.

backends.description: List of backend IMAP servers to which the proxy will forward client requests.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the backend IMAP server.

port.description: Port of the backend IMAP server.

auth_method.description: Authentication method used to validate user credentials.

ldap_uri.description: URI of the LDAP server (used only when auth_method = ldap).

ldap_base_dn.description: Base distinguished name (DN) for LDAP searches.

ldap_bind_dn.description: DN used to bind to the LDAP directory for user lookup.

ldap_bind_password.description: Password for LDAP bind DN (store securely in production).

ldap_filter.description: LDAP search filter for authenticating users (replace %u with username).

sql_driver.description: SQL driver/backend (used only when auth_method = sql).

sql_host.description: Hostname or IP of SQL server (used only when auth_method = sql).

sql_port.description: Port of SQL server (used only when auth_method = sql).

sql_user.description: Username for SQL connection (used only when auth_method = sql).

sql_password.description: Password for SQL connection (store securely in production).

sql_database.description: Database name for SQL queries (used only when auth_method = sql).

sql_query.default: SELECT password FROM users WHERE username = '%u' AND active = 1
sql_query.description: SQL query to fetch user password (replace %u with username).

use_cache.description: Enable caching of IMAP responses to reduce backend load.

cache_dir.description: Directory where cache files are stored (used only if use_cache = true).

cache_size.description: Maximum number of cache entries (used only if use_cache = true).

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging (syslog or file).

log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging to syslog.

log_file.description: Path to log file (used only if logging to file is configured).

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS for client connections (e.g., imaps://).

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required if ssl_enabled = true).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key file (required if ssl_enabled = true).

ssl_ciphers.description: Allowed cipher suites (colon-separated or space-separated, depending on OpenSSL version).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections.

server_timeout.description: Idle timeout (seconds) for backend server connections.

transparent_proxy.description: Enable transparent proxy mode (preserves client source IP).

use_starttls.description: Enable STARTTLS support for plain IMAP connections.
